---
id: humpback-whale
title: Humpback whale
---
The humpback whale (*Megaptera novaeangliae*) is a baleen rorqual. In
productive months it lunges on krill and small fish at high latitude;
later the same animals appear in low-latitude waters to calve and sing.
The circuit can span an ocean basin. Pectoral fins are extremely long;
throat pleats expand the gulp. Baleen plates replace teeth.
